name: Washington
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Washington's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): Cape Alava and Tatoosh Island in the west, the Columbia River in the south, the Canadian border in the north, Idaho in the east. The San Juan Islands and Puget Sound are inside the box; open Pacific west of the Olympic coast is trimmed. The box takes in part of southern British Columbia, Vancouver Island's south end included. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-wa.
